---
title: "Web services"
---

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
status <- read_status()
apis <- read_apis()
```

The ICES web services (APIs) called by the packages. Every day each endpoint
is called with example values, and the structure of the response (the names
of the fields, their types, and the format of text values such as dates) is
compared with a recorded baseline. This finds changes that can break the
packages, such as a field renamed from `AssessmentKey` to `assessmentKey`, a
field removed, or a number returned as text. Where the API has
machine-readable documentation, changes to the documented operations and
their parameters are also found. Checked `r updated(apis)`.

```{r}
#| results: asis
md_table(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(apis$apis, function(a) {
    eps <- endpoint_table(a)
    users <- api_packages(a, status)
    n <- table(factor(eps$status, levels = c("ok", "changed", "no baseline", "error")))
    data.frame(
      API = sprintf("[%s](api/%s.html)", a$name, a$id),
      Status = as.character(badge(
        c(ok = "No changes", warning = "Changes found", error = "Errors")[[a$health]],
        c(ok = "success", warning = "warning", error = "danger")[[a$health]]
      )),
      Endpoints = sprintf("%d: %d unchanged, %d changed, %d with errors", nrow(eps), n[["ok"]], n[["changed"]], n[["error"]]),
      `Median time (s)` = median(eps$time_s, na.rm = TRUE),
      Documentation = if (!is.null(a$docs)) sprintf("[%s](%s)", if (is.null(a$spec)) "Yes" else paste(length(a$spec$operations), "operations"), a$docs) else "None",
      `Used by` = paste(package_link(c(users$direct, users$via), status), collapse = ", "),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  })),
  align = "lllrll"
)
```

## Adding an API or endpoint

Each web service has a folder in
[apis/](https://github.com/ices-tools-prod/ices-tools-prod.github.io/tree/main/apis),
with a `config.json` that lists its endpoints, its documentation, and notes
shown on its page. For each endpoint, give a path with example query values
that return a stable result, such as a published assessment.

## Accepting a change

When a change is expected, for example after the package has been updated to
use the new field names, record a new baseline:

```sh
Rscript scripts/check_apis.R --update-baseline
```

and commit the `baseline.json` files in `apis/`.
